scientificRationale: The proposed DEEN body correctly separates mutation creating variants, recombination rearranging existing information, and selection changing heritable-variant frequency through differential reproduction. It removes the false attribution of variant generation to selection.
atomicityRationale: Generation/recombination and frequency change are linked functions within one causal population explanation, rather than three unrelated memorised routines.
memoryRationale: The causal distinction is explained in a new example; no additional fixed molecular term or formula deck is necessary.
